title: Oven Roasted Canadian Tofu Custard
description: A salty, light, and cozy Canadian dish featuring custard, made with Jain-friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection in a Korean brass bowl. This recipe combines the richness of tofu with the comfort of a warm, roasted custard.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine the non-dairy milk, cornstarch, nutritional yeast, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Add the crumbled tofu to the blender and blend until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a Korean brass bowl.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top of the mixture.
Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and roast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until the custard is set and lightly browned.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
